title: Gradient Break - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)

facts.label: Location

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Gradient Break is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Breaking grants Gradient Charge.

sections.title: How to Get Gradient Break
sections.content: Location: Endless Night Sanctuary - dark corner near the Grandis Engineer.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
